Tech / requirements summary:
- Workload: conversational chat with streaming; some system prompts + user + small context (<= 2k tokens typical).
- Latency target: p50 <= 250ms for token stream headroom; p95 < 800ms. Emphasis on tail latency and jitter.
- Throughput: concurrent websocket streams ~200 across accounts at scale (SMB phase).
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for lower latency but monitoring token/unit economics.
- Model preferences: open-model first (Llama2/Mistral) but flexible to higher-quality hosted models if latency and cost align. Wants ability to route cheaper model for low-critical flows.
- Routing/fallback: needs simple policy to fallback to smaller model under load; feels like Redwood routing + variant fallback is strong fit.
- Caching: interested in prefix/KV caching for repeated boilerplate prompts (UX templates).
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML for admin portal, audit logs for user actions, retention controls (default 30d) — SOC2 talk later. No air-gapped/on-prem now.
